We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the sample's compound. We have no direct description of the compound. We can get NMR spectra to infer methyl groups. Use proton NMR to see signals around 0.9 ppm (triplet) etc. Could also use carbon NMR for methyl carbon ~10-30 ppm.

We need to decide which tool to use. Probably get proton NMR first. Use proton_nmr_spectra (no input needed? It says takes SMILES string, but we have no SMILES. The tool signature: proton_nmr_spectra = (_: {}) => any. No parameters. So it will return the 1H NMR for the sample at hand (the unknown). Let's call it.
